description: FloodAdapt is Deltares' public planning system for compound flood and impact scenarios. It connects rapid physics-based flood modelling with impact calculations in an interface where a community can compare future conditions and adaptation measures. Users specify a study area, water and weather events, terrain and exposure data, and proposed interventions; outputs are flood and impact maps and comparison metrics. Geographic coverage is user-defined; each run represents a selected event or future scenario. The GitHub source and Deltares software release are available under GPL-3.0 without a software fee. A limitation is that a credible local baseline still needs elevation, assets and calibration data; a fast what-if result is not a flood forecast. FloodAdapt supports flood-defence and community adaptation studies. The first review prepared model-sfincs for one flood engine, but the catalogue's model-lisflood-fp is an existing separate flood solver for comparison. The round-one candidate remained in review because its product page had not been opened; the provider page and code were verified today. No installer or demonstration database was downloaded.
